statements.impact_statement: Measured 2026-11-17 on Envoy 1.40.2. The advisory is for gRPC-Go (GHSA ecosystem go, package google.golang.org/grpc, fixed in 1.83.1/1.83.2). Envoy links gRPC C++ core (Bazel module grpc 1.83.0.envoy from Envoy's registry) and contains no Go code; the inventory scan matches it only through the shared CPE cpe:2.3:a:grpc:grpc. Revisit if a gRPC C++ advisory with the same identifier appears.
